name: Conscription
texts: You may spend 5 XP as an additional cost to play this. Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3 :rb_might: or less. If you paid the additional cost, choose any enemy unit at a battlefield instead. Take control of it, exhaust it, and recall it.
manual: You may spend 5 XP as an additional cost to play this.
Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3 :rb_might: or less.
If you paid the additional cost, choose any enemy unit at a battlefield instead.
Take control of it, exhaust it, and recall it.
